make lint and make typecheck were not executed; this plan changes no src/ file. Only make -n dry runs and the underlying commands were run.
The SBOM and audit service branches are exercised only by make -n expansion; the desk-signer export and pip-audit path has no service to run against.

The wildcard in the plan text, $(wildcard services/*/src), matches services/desk-gateway/src at this base. mypy --strict fails there (server.py:385), so the gate uses services/desk-signer/src. This deviates from the literal wildcard and needs owner review.
Compose hardening was validated by parsing and docker compose config only. No container was started, so read-only root behaviour at runtime is unproven.

.receipts/bot-02-risk/v4-p11-quality-foundation.json is written but not tracked: the base .gitignore ignores .receipts/**/*.json. Tracking depends on the D-06 glob from plan 11-01, which is not on this base.
coverage.xml and .coverage are generated and left untracked; .gitignore is not in files_modified, so they are not ignored.
The four red-before-change exit codes were not captured by the executor; those four tests were re-run on the current tree instead (rows marked re-run now), so no red exit code is claimed.
Plan 11-04 did not run make test, the full pytest -q, the soak suite, run_all.py, or any gate script, per the plan rules; the orchestrator runs the gates.
make cov was not re-run for 11-04; the coverage floor in pyproject.toml is unchanged, but the new modules were not measured against it.

'one import and one field line per section' is implemented as one import statement per section module (core, engine, ops), not one import line per section, because files_modified allows only those three section modules.

settings.py and cli/backtest.py re-export section and helper names through explicit __all__ lists so that promotion.py, scoring.py, analyzer.py and the test modules keep their imports unchanged; those importer files are outside files_modified and were not migrated.

An owner-checkout incident: two edit calls with a relative path landed in /root/src/repos/pumpgrok (core.py, branch bot-00-chief/phase-6-integrity). Main restored that file to HEAD; the owner checkout was not re-verified by this executor after the restore.

The doctor probe still reports typed network failures as warn lines (never fatal). Only unexpected exceptions now propagate; no live endpoint was started for the new error tests, which use stubbed urlopen.
